geometria.cos_phi: per node (cosine of the node's own latitude)

split.regra_buffer: train intact; val trimmed against train; test trimmed against train U val(trimmed)

verificacao.nota_validate_spatial_cv: run on a subsample of <=20k per set (cdist is O(n*m)); the exhaustive check is the cKDTree above

train.nota_indices: idx_sha256_global = sha256 of the SORTED int64 indices in the original dataset; idx_sha256_local_janela likewise, relative to the contiguous subsample

val.nota_indices: idx_sha256_global = sha256 of the SORTED int64 indices in the original dataset; idx_sha256_local_janela likewise, relative to the contiguous subsample

test.nota_indices: idx_sha256_global = sha256 of the SORTED int64 indices in the original dataset; idx_sha256_local_janela likewise, relative to the contiguous subsample

normalizacao.decisao: [D1] TRAINING mean/std (the original train_lins_physics.py:569-571 used all nodes = test statistics in the standardization)

guarda_particao_degenerada.significado: partition with 0 ant->ter edges and 0 valid PL targets does not test the antenna path; the RSSI MAE there is a regression on the constant sentinel of -110 dBm

subgrafos.declaracao: Each partition is the subgraph INDUCED by its own terrain nodes plus ALL antennas. Inference on val and on test uses only context from its own region: no edge links nodes of different partitions, in any of the 4 encoder layers.

baselines_analiticos.decisao: [D2] P_tx_eff calibrated ONLY with training targets and applied unchanged to val/test (the original calibrated on the evaluated set itself: train_lins_physics.py:186-193)

loss.nota_frequencia: [C0-4] the original did not pass frequency_mhz -> default 900 MHz (physics_loss.py:36) in the loss, while RFDiagnosticMetrics audited with 1800 MHz (rf_diagnostic_metrics.py:38)
loss.fonte_de_distances: [C0-1] dist_to_nearest_antenna in meters, aligned node by node (before: edge_attr[:n_seed,0]*15000)

selecao.nota: [D4] the per-epoch test in `epocas[].test` is diagnostic; the reportable number is `selecao.test_no_melhor_ckpt`, measured a single time on the checkpoint chosen by val.

_fontes.modelo.n_params_treinaveis: sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)

escalas.coverage_prob: sigmoid(raw) (the only compressed channel; see rf_decoder_v3.py)

modelo_v3.nota: decoder replaced by a monkeypatch of gnn_rf_model.PhysicsConstrainedDecoder BEFORE model=GNNRFModel(...); no line of the frozen code was edited.

insumos.nota_graph_file: _gpu.pt (terrain-terrain edges) has no entry of its own in manifest v4/group tensores_cftudo (only the 16 .pt files of canonical data enriched_cftudo do); sha256 recorded for provenance, with no gate on it.

diagnostico_treino.definicao_pos_aquecimento: skips after the index of the 1st step WITHOUT a skip (1st successful update)
diagnostico_treino.nota_normas_nao_finitas: non-finite pre-clip norm (inf/nan) occurs in the steps that GradScaler detects and skips (P3 of the internal note); excluded from P50/P99, counted here

capacidade.medido_em: 1 real batch from the TRAINING loader of this run (forward+backward, on a copy of the model)

diagnostico_avaliacao.regra: num_neighbors=-1 in the 3 relations (AT,TT,TA), disjoint=True, in val and test

teste_invariancia.nota: with FULL neighborhood there is no neighbor sampling (actual degree <= 9 in TT, <=5 in AT -- *_grau_vizinhanca.json): the only expected source of difference is GPU numerical-reduction noise (not bit-exact across calls), measured here by the 'floor' and used as the scale reference of the decision criterion.
